outcome: High umbilical cord blood base deficit (>=10 mEq/L)
cohort: 19 pregnant women hospitalized with mild or asymptomatic COVID-19 and disseminated intravascular coagulation.
finding: Clinicians should be alert to the possibility of disseminated intravascular coagulation in pregnant women with COVID-19, even if mild or asymptomatic, who present with decreased fetal movement in the early third trimester.
gest_age: Median gestational age on hospital admission was 30 weeks (interquartile range, 29-34 weeks).
